name: Creature Equipment Template (Raw)
description: Deprecated raw variant of creature_equip_template: equipment defined directly by item display ids plus packed item info and virtual item slot values instead of item entries. Only used for ids that have no row in creature_equip_template.

fields.name: Entry
fields.help: Equipment template id, referenced by creature_template.EquipmentTemplateId. Must not duplicate an id already present in creature_equip_template.

fields.name: Model 1 (Main Hand)
fields.help: Item display id shown in the main hand slot.

fields.name: Model 2 (Off Hand)
fields.help: Item display id shown in the off hand slot.

fields.name: Model 3 (Ranged)
fields.help: Item display id shown in the ranged slot.

fields.name: Info 1
fields.help: Packed virtual item info bytes (item class, subclass, material, inventory type, sheath) for slot 1.

fields.name: Info 2
fields.help: Packed virtual item info bytes (item class, subclass, material, inventory type, sheath) for slot 2.

fields.name: Info 3
fields.help: Packed virtual item info bytes (item class, subclass, material, inventory type, sheath) for slot 3.

fields.name: Slot 1
fields.help: Additional virtual item slot info for slot 1.

fields.name: Slot 2
fields.help: Additional virtual item slot info for slot 2.

fields.name: Slot 3
fields.help: Additional virtual item slot info for slot 3.
